_comment: Local API-key template: copy beside the chosen app's host.json and replace placeholders. Change node to python or dotnet-isolated for those runtimes. Start Azurite for UseDevelopmentStorage=true, or omit storage for HTTP-only local use. Provider credentials stay in Key Vault. Local hosts have no Easy Auth; keep them on loopback. See README.md for Azure settings and optional OAuth configuration.

Values.EPP_DECRYPTION_KEY_PEM: <base64 of your local test private PEM>
